quest.title: Cleanup At Dawn II
quest.description: At the behest of head housemaid Adelinde, maids Moco and Hillie have begun cleaning up. However, they seem to have run into a spot of trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: What're we gonna do!?

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Adelinde is totally gonna freak out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: So, Adelinde asked us to tidy up the area around the Winery.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Most places were fine, but there are all these haystacks lying around.

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Connor said he's storing them here because he needs them for something.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: They're bound pretty tight, so at least they didn't get blown away in the wind. But still, a load of leaves got blown in among the hay.

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: We worked really hard at it, but we still didn't manage to get all the leaves out.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: If we keep on at this pace, the head housemaid Adelinde is gonna freak out... What're we gonna do?

choices.text: So, the leaves are hard to get rid of?

response.speaker: Hillie
response.text: When they're mixed in with the hay they sure are. We have to pick them out one by one, which takes forever...

response.speaker: Hillie
response.text: If you've got a better idea, I'm all ears!

talks.objective: Sweep up the pile of leaves

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: How did it go?

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Did you get them all?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Every last one.

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Oh my gosh, you're awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Traveler, you're the best person ever!

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Thanks! Now Adelinde won't be on our backs.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Please take these as our thank-you gift.

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Right, we've got other places to clean now. Thanks again! See you.

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: What did you go and do that for!? You've burned down the haystack!

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Gee thanks... now Adelinde's gonna freak out for sure — and on top of that, she's definitely gonna fire us too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was an accident...

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Ugh, we should've just kept on picking them out one by one.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: Darn it... There's no way back from this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I, ah...

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Traveler, you'd better get outta here. This was our responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: It's our fault for getting someone to help who doesn't know a thing about cleaning.

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: What is Adelinde gonna do when she finds out...

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: She's gonna be so mad...

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Ugh, my clothes are filthy now.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: And we didn't even clear out all the leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: What're we gonna do?

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: Ugh, my clothes are filthy now.

dialogues.speaker: Hillie
dialogues.text: And we didn't even clear out all the leaves.

dialogues.speaker: Moco
dialogues.text: What're we gonna do?
